notes: P0 freeze fix plus Ocean clarity. 3.11.12 could freeze because provider bubble groups caused a self-triggering childList MutationObserver/render loop while water drift wrote style every animation frame and global observers watched style/class changes; collision also ran an O(n^2) pass every 1.1s. 3.11.13 removes those feedback loops, makes collision event-driven, caps drift to ~25fps and pauses hidden-tab work, and scopes observers to relevant nodes. Bubble groups are clearer and open into a blurred focus surface showing members; Layers is again a detached top-left bubble; Inspector overlays without moving the dock and starts closed on idle Ocean; black/heavy Ocean surfaces are replaced by lighter glass.
